races.title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
races.verdict: NESWICK proved suited by the step up in trip when making a winning start to life in handicaps at Southwell and can defy a 2 lb weights rise with likely better still to come from this lightly-raced sort. Wolverhampton scorer Fiefdom also has relatively few miles on the clock and is feared most, while the handily-weighted Percy Jones and C&D winner Fair Dinkum can also have a say in this intriguing handicap. NESWICK FIEFDOM (IRE) PERCY JONES

races.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Nursery
races.verdict: The 2 interesting ones PRIDE'S QUEEN and Hemustbeanangel are drawn on the outside, which isn't ideal, but they are still expected to come to the fore. Ready preference is for the Botti filly given her latest second can be upgraded quite a lot. Rocsane may keep on for a place. PRIDE'S QUEEN HEMUSTBEANANGEL (IRE) ROCSANE (IRE)

races.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Not a deep maiden so it could be worth chancing GREEN SPAIN , who didn't show masses on debut in France this summer but that was a pretty warm race and her pedigree and connections suggest she'll up her game. Uomo Valeroso showed enough starting out at Kempton to think he'll be involved, with Rhythm Runner , Gilded Outlaw and Sand On The Run interesting newcomers on paper. GREEN SPAIN UOMO VALEROSO (USA) RHYTHM RUNNER

races.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
races.verdict: DEFIANT DREAM took a step forward when runner-up at Nottingham last time and is weighted to go one better and gain a first success off just a 1 lb higher mark here. Fancied Angel didn't enjoy the rub of the green when a recent fifth at Wolverhampton and is next on the list with likely better to come. Last Dandelion and Past Passion appeal also and need considering in this open nursery. DEFIANT DREAM FANCIED ANGEL LAST DANDELION

races.title: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: TRUSTINTIMES can call upon a very good strike rate and with this trip sure to suit on second Flat start, he can find the necessary improvement required to land this. Liam Mera Kai is a definite threat back on a left-handed track, with Rowlf another potential improver. TRUSTINTIMES LIAM MERA KAI (FR) ROWLF

races.title: ARC 1M Bonus Handicap
races.verdict: A few of these arrive with a question mark against them and it could pay to side with REY DE LA BATALLA , who hinted at a revival when fourth at Kempton last time and can race off a 1 lb lower mark now. In-form Valentine Boy could prove the chief threat, although Sant Alessio is also weighted to go well if back on song. REY DE LA BATALLA VALENTINE BOY SANT ALESSIO (IRE)

races.title: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict: On the back of a fair return to action for new connections, TEGGY LASSO is fancied to take a step forward here with a raft of engagements in the coming days perhaps a sign of intent. Twitch is an in-form rival with a good draw to exploit, while Lessay is back at a much more realistic level. TEGGY LASSO (IRE) TWITCH (NZ) LESSAY (IRE)

races.title: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict: TAM LIN shaped well after an absence on his first start for Mick Appleby when a recent Southwell fourth, fading only late on, and looks the way to go here with that run under his belt. races.title: AWC Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap
races.verdict: James Owen looked to be finding the key to MERITOCRATIC before he was sent hurdling minus headgear and he's tentatively selected to shed his maiden status back on all-weather. Far Far Out is a solid rival, with Herstmonceux and Intsaar potential improvers. MERITOCRATIC (IRE) FAR FAR OUT (IRE) HERSTMONCEUX
